title: Device for the automatic inserting of products into envelopes

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a device for inserting products into envelopes, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip portion.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: Device ( 11 ) according to claim 1 , characterised in that said gripping element of said tab ( 24 ) comprises a lower suction cup ( 39 ) that is connected to a vacuum source.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum source connected to a suction cup, implying an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
features.refuted: The quote describes a suction cup connected to a vacuum source but does not specify that the vacuum generating device is electrically operated.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet

claims.quote: Device ( 11 ) for the automatic inserting of products into envelopes, such as printed products or sheets ( 12 ) in individual envelopes ( 13 )
claims.note: The reference describes a 'Device for the automatic inserting of products into envelopes', which is a type of handling apparatus, but it is not specifically a 'vacuum handling apparatus' as a whole, although it uses vacuum elements.
The reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around it.
The reference does not describe a 'grip unit according to claim 1' as claim 1 is from a different patent document and not provided in this reference.

This reference describes a device for inserting products into envelopes, which uses suction cups and a sucked conveyor belt. However, it does not mention a grip unit and a suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.
